lifecycle.description: active and final artifacts may be consumed; readers and admission gates must ignore or reject superseded artifacts.

producer_role.description: Workflow role on the artifact-authorship axis (who wrote this artifact), not the --role dispatch axis. WORKER is the current value for the Implementation seat; CODEX is accepted only as a legacy producer identity.

producer_runtime.description: Runtime that produced this artifact; required for runtime-neutral artifacts.

producer_version.description: Observed runtime CLI version; required for runtime-neutral artifacts.

head_sha.description: Git HEAD observed by CODEX when the scoped abort artifact was produced.

reason_code.description: Pick the closest cause; do NOT free-write the cause as prose.

blocking_fact.description: The CONCRETE observed fact naming ACTUAL files/symbols hit. Never copy phrasing from the dispatch prompt.

needed_decision.description: The specific human/ARCHITECT decision required to unblock.
